answer: Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each tinplate is a season of logged solderings plus a signed tin record, and that is why Tin solderer tinplate mark soldered into the trimming bench guards the door. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. An honest proof costs 159 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 377 of them, which totals 59943 POA. A ferrous can be painted, a spiral can be borrowed, but a whisper must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing.
